counting_rules.public_totals_source: canonical proof identities, not filesystem paths
counting_rules.alias_rule: a byte-identical proof kept at another path is the SAME commitment and is never counted as a second confirmed artifact
counting_rules.snapshot_rule: each ledger snapshot is a distinct commitment with its own proof
counting_rules.metadata_rule: original-publication and current-revision metadata proofs are distinct identities because they commit to different digests
